_criterion: C0-9 - DR-011 normalization policy configured and documented
_status: CONFIGURATION, not a measurement. Applies to C0 and carries into C1.
policy: per-volume intensity normalization computed from the volume being processed
forbidden: mean or standard deviation computed across the training set and applied at inference
percentile clipping thresholds derived from the cohort
any statistic that sees the validation or test partition
why: A statistic fitted across the cohort leaks information between partitions and inflates
every metric that follows it. C1-7 asks for explicit confirmation that no cohort-fitted
statistic appears anywhere, which is only checkable if the policy is written down first.

implementation.step_1: clip to the per-volume [p_low, p_high] percentiles
implementation.step_3: no mean subtraction, no division by a cohort standard deviation
implementation.note: The percentile bounds are a configuration choice, not a measurement. They are recorded here so a reviewer can disagree with a specific number rather than with a vibe.

verified_by: C1-7 - DR-011 normalization conformance confirmed, no cohort-fitted statistics anywhere
